meta.description: Grand Hills Resort knowledge-base evaluation set (synthetic). Evidence strings are verbatim (whitespace-normalised) quotes from an expected document. 'dev' calibrates the refusal thresholds; 'test' is held out for reporting.

questions.question: Can I cancel for free two days before arrival?
questions.evidence: free of charge until 48 hours before the scheduled arrival

questions.question: How much is charged if a guest cancels within 48 hours of arrival?
questions.evidence: charged one night's room rate including taxes

questions.question: What is the free cancellation window during peak season?
questions.evidence: free cancellation window is 7 days before arrival

questions.question: Which dates count as peak season?
questions.evidence: 1 April to 30 June and from 20 December to 5 January

questions.question: Until when can a pool villa booking be cancelled without a charge?
questions.evidence: until 14 days before arrival in all seasons

questions.question: Can a guest on the advance purchase rate get their money back?
questions.evidence: Only the General Manager may approve an exception

questions.question: What happens if a guest never shows up?
questions.evidence: The first night is charged and all remaining nights are cancelled automatically

questions.question: A guest who booked through an OTA wants to cancel. Who processes the refund?
questions.evidence: must be processed through the OTA

questions.question: How long do refunds take to reach the guest?
questions.evidence: within 7 business days

questions.question: Who can waive a cancellation fee larger than one night?
questions.evidence: Any waiver above one night requires approval from the General Manager

questions.question: What time is check-in and check-out?
questions.evidence: Check-in time is 14:00 and check-out time is 11:00

questions.question: How much is the incidental deposit at check-in?
questions.evidence: incidental deposit of ₹5,000 per room per stay

questions.question: Do Gold members get late checkout for free?
questions.evidence: complimentary for Gold and Platinum loyalty members

questions.question: What does it cost to stay in the room until 6 pm on departure day?
questions.evidence: until 18:00 is charged at 50 percent of the nightly room rate

questions.question: What documents do foreign nationals need at check-in?
questions.evidence: passport and a valid visa

questions.question: Is early check-in at 10 am free?
questions.evidence: Early check-in from 10:00 is free of charge, subject to availability

questions.question: How many rooms does the hotel have in total?
questions.evidence: Grand Hills Resort has 80 rooms

questions.question: Which rooms are suitable for wheelchair users?
questions.evidence: Rooms 101 and 102 are accessible rooms with a roll-in shower

questions.question: How big is the Hillside Suite?
questions.evidence: 65 square metres

questions.question: What is the rack rate for a Deluxe Valley View room?
questions.evidence: Rack rate ₹9,000

questions.question: Do villa guests get a butler?
questions.evidence: dedicated butler from 07:00 to 23:00

questions.question: How much does an extra bed cost?
questions.evidence: An extra bed costs ₹2,000 per night

questions.question: Do young children stay for free?
questions.evidence: Children under 6 years stay free when using existing bedding

questions.question: How much is a beer from the minibar?
questions.evidence: local craft beer ₹450

questions.question: What time is breakfast served?
questions.evidence: breakfast buffet is served from 07:00 to 10:30

questions.question: Is Ember Grill open on Mondays?
questions.evidence: closed on Mondays

questions.question: When does the bar close?
questions.evidence: Open daily from 16:00 to 00:00, with last orders at 23:30

questions.question: How much is high tea?
questions.evidence: High tea is served from 16:00 to 18:00 for ₹950 per person

questions.question: Can guests bring their own birthday cake to the restaurant?
questions.evidence: cake-cutting fee of ₹500

questions.question: Can I order food to my room at 2 am?
questions.evidence: limited night menu is served from 23:00 to 06:30

questions.question: How quickly should room service orders be delivered?
questions.evidence: delivered within 30 minutes for the full menu

questions.question: Is there an extra charge for in-room dining?
questions.evidence: A tray charge of ₹200 applies to every in-room dining order

questions.question: How much is the butter chicken on the room service menu?
questions.evidence: Butter chicken with naan: ₹850

questions.question: What should a server do when a guest says they have a nut allergy?
questions.evidence: mark the ticket with the red ALLERGY stamp

questions.question: Can the kitchen prepare Jain food?
questions.evidence: Jain meals, prepared without onion, garlic or root vegetables, are available with two hours' notice

questions.question: What is Code Red?
questions.evidence: A fire or smoke emergency is announced as Code Red

questions.question: Where do guests gather during a fire evacuation?
questions.evidence: The main assembly point is the front lawn near the main gate

questions.question: Can we use the elevator during a fire?
questions.evidence: Never use the lifts during a fire

questions.question: Which internal number do I dial for a medical emergency?
questions.evidence: Dial 5555 and report Code Blue

questions.question: Where are the defibrillators kept?
questions.evidence: Automated external defibrillators (AEDs) are kept at the front desk

questions.question: How far away is the nearest hospital?
questions.evidence: Hillcrest District Hospital, 14 kilometres away

questions.question: How quickly does backup power come on during an outage?
questions.evidence: restored within 15 seconds

questions.question: Are treks cancelled during the monsoon?
questions.evidence: guided treks and the sunrise viewpoint drive are suspended

questions.question: What do we do for guests if a landslide blocks the road?
questions.evidence: offers to extend stays at the same rate

questions.question: How much compensation can a supervisor approve for a complaint?
questions.evidence: A supervisor may approve compensation up to ₹5,000

questions.question: What does the LEARN approach stand for?
questions.evidence: Listen to the guest without interrupting

questions.question: A guest says they got food poisoning. Can I offer them a free dinner?
questions.evidence: Staff must not offer compensation or admit liability

questions.question: The air conditioning in a guest's room can't be repaired quickly. What should we offer?
questions.evidence: offer the guest a room move

questions.question: How fast should front desk staff greet arriving guests?
questions.evidence: Greet every arriving guest within 30 seconds

questions.question: How many key cards do we give per room?
questions.evidence: Issue two key cards per room

questions.question: What welcome drink is offered at arrival?
questions.evidence: chilled lemongrass tea

questions.question: How long does a departure clean of a pool villa take?
questions.evidence: Departure clean, Private Pool Villas: 90 minutes

questions.question: What does the room status inspected mean?
questions.evidence: a supervisor has inspected the room and it is ready to sell

questions.question: What should housekeeping do if the Do Not Disturb sign is still up in the afternoon?
questions.evidence: still displayed at 15:00

questions.question: How long do we keep a lost passport?
questions.evidence: Valuables are kept for 180 days

questions.question: Can we send a forgotten item to a guest who has already left?
questions.evidence: shipped by courier at the guest's cost

questions.question: Can I smoke on my balcony?
questions.evidence: All rooms, villas and indoor areas are non-smoking

questions.question: Are dogs allowed at the hotel?
questions.evidence: Pets are not allowed at the resort

questions.question: Is there a lifeguard at the pool?
questions.evidence: There is no lifeguard on duty

questions.question: What are the quiet hours?
questions.evidence: Quiet hours are from 22:00 to 07:00

questions.question: Someone on the phone asks which room a guest is staying in. What do I say?
questions.evidence: Never give a guest's room number to a caller or visitor

questions.question: How do I verify a caller before discussing their booking?
questions.evidence: confirmation code and the guest's last name

questions.question: What should I do if a guest has an allergic reaction during dinner?
questions.evidence: call Code Blue immediately by dialling 5555

questions.question: What happens to the pool during a thunderstorm?
questions.evidence: the pool and outdoor areas are closed
